review_candidates.title: Product Manager eHealth
review_candidates.description: Somos SenseisTalent, el partner de recruitment de grandes empresas en España y Europa. Fusionamos la experiencia de RRHH, Hiring Managers y especialistas de diversos sectores para acabar con procesos tradicionales, eternos e ineficaces. Descripción del empleo Posición: Product Owner/Manager Localización: Barcelona Industria: eHealth Tipo: Middle | Modalidad: Híbrido El contexto Buscamos un Product Owner/Manager para unirse al equipo de uno de nuestros clientes top, startup líder del sector eHealth en España. Ayudan a las personas a cuidarse sin necesidad de acudir a un centro médico. A través de apps ofrecen servicios de telemedicina en modelo B2B2C, conectando a usuarios con médicos de distintas especialidades al momento y 24/7. El equipo de producto está viviendo un momento de crecimiento: evolución de roles internos y un ecosistema de producto que no para de expandirse (apps, SDKs, widgets, back-office). Necesitan a alguien capaz de aportar estructura y avanzar con autonomía, para trabajar con el equipo de ingeniería, diseño, operaciones médicas y clientes, siendo la persona que traduce necesidades reales en producto tangible. La misión Definir y materializar los productos y servicios digitales de telemedicina, traduciendo las necesidades de usuarios, profesionales médicos y negocio en soluciones concretas. Acompañarás cada desarrollo de principio a fin: desde el discovery hasta el refinamiento con el equipo técnico, asegurando que lo que se construye resuelve un problema real. Responsabilidades clave Análisis de necesidades convirtiéndolas en experiencias para el usuario y los profesionales médicos Definición de requerimientos: Desde los flujos a las lógicas de negocio. Acompañamiento del squad para el desarrollo de nuevo productos Asistencia a reuniones con clientes para entender problemáticas y ayudar en el delivery de nuevos servicios. Gestión de sprints en Jira y documentación en Confluence Discovery en sector health constante: User research, tendencias de mercado, innovación etc. Seguimiento de impacto en métricas: analytics y Qlik Requisitos +3 años de experiencia como Product Manager o Product Owner, con experiencia previa trabajando en aplicaciones móviles. Dominio de Figma para crear flujos e iterar sobre diseños. Curiosidad activa por LLMs, agentes IA y automatizaciones, con casos de uso propios aplicados a tu trabajo. Experiencia en APPS Gestión de backlog en metodologías Scrum. Capacidad de discovery y user research aplicados a producto digital. Manejo de user story mapping y bajada de requerimientos a user stories. Comodidad hablando con perfiles técnicos (backend, frontend y mobile) y entendiendo conceptos básicos como SDKs o widgets. Orientación a datos y a objetivos: uso de analytics y KPIs mobile para tomar decisiones. Ventajas Formar parte del equipo ejecutivo de la startup líder en eHealth en España. Crecimiento y desarrollo profesional en un sector en plena expansión. Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes. Modelo híbrido: 2 días de oficina y 3 de teletrabajo. Presupuesto anual para formación individualizada. Payflow para retribución flexible y adelanto de nómina (dietas, transporte, seguros, guardería...). 23 días laborables de vacaciones + el día de tu cumpleaños.

review_candidates.description: Job Purpose: Promote and sell Al Maha Services and lounges to walk-in customers, create bookings based on online/email requests and answer customer enquiries to achieve the assigned revenue targets within prescribed time frames. Assist the corporate sales team in order to achieve revenue targets and deliver exceptional service to our customers inside and outside Qatar Airways along with efficient handling of day to day sales-related activities following the standard procedures. Operations: ▪ Promote and sell Al Maha Services and lounges to walk-in customers to drive sales growth and meet sales targets. ▪ Respond to customers’ phone/email enquiries in a timely manner and generate sales from those enquiries. ▪ Seek opportunities to upsell higher value Al Maha Services and add-on products to increase value and profitability per customer. ▪ Check-in customers to lounge/s and manage lounge capacity appropriately to ensure the customer experience is optimized. ▪ Support corporate sales team and assist with client and event bookings. ▪ Support Management with administrative, sales and marketing activities and reports related to Sales Department. ▪ Understand industry trends, identify business opportunities and assist customers with their lounge and meet & assist services needs. ▪ Service existing bookings, obtain new bookings and suggest process improvements, new products and service features to sales team. ▪ Participate in daily operations in lounges, back office and touchpoints as per Standard Operating Procedures [SOP] relevant to unit in which assigned. ▪ Ensure billing, cash/POS handling shift closing and handover procedures are followed at all times. ▪ Ensure visual appearance of work and lounge areas is of the highest standard by regular monitoring. ▪ Ensure compliance with corporate and department policies, procedures and standard operating procedures, E-docs and eLearning’s (Mandatory and otherwise) are always up-to-date. Perform other department duties related to his/her position as directed by the Head of the Department. ▪ Perform other department duties related to his / her position as directed by the Head of the Department About Qatar Airways Group Our story started with four aircraft. Today, we deliver excellent results across 12 different businesses coming together as one. We’ve grown fast, broken records and set trends that others follow. We don’t slow down because of failure. Instead, we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. So, whether you’re creating a unique experience for our customers or innovating behind the scenes, every person contributes to our proud story. A story of spectacular growth and determination. Now is the time to bring your best ideas and passion to a place where your ambition will know no boundaries and be part of a truly global community Qualifications: High School Qualification with Minimum 1 year of job-related experience Formal qualifications in sales or related field. Job Specific Skills: Working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook/Word/Excel or similar. Create value, influence others and create needs for service. Demonstrate effective business like communication skills, both verbal and written. Genuine service/people focused attitude and understanding of needs of multi-cultural working/operating environment High level of interpersonal skills with the ability to motivate and promote a positive team environment. Understanding of premium hospitality/airline/airport operations. Knowledge of Arabic language. Knowledge of airline or hotel booking system. Knowledge of point of sales processes and system. Be part of an extraordinary story Your skills. Your imagination. Your ambition. Here, there are no boundaries to your potential and the impact you can make. You’ll find infinite opportunities to grow and work on the biggest, most rewarding challenges that will build your skills and experience. You have the chance to be a part of our future and build the life you want while being part of an international community. Our best is here and still to come. To us, impossible is only a challenge. Join us as we dare to achieve what’s never been done before. Together, everything is possible
